item.title: Houston man shoots at robbers after gun range attack, HPD says
item.description: A man fired back, at robbers, who police say followed him from a gun range in southwest Houston.

item.title: Juvenile victim shot in Springwoods Village Parkway incident
item.description: Constable deputies investigate a shooting in Spring, Texas. Juvenile victim sustains multiple gunshot wounds. Investigation ongoing.

item.title: Texas Republicans target Sharia Law as threat to Texas in campaign messaging for 2026 primaries
item.description: Congressman Chip Roy, R-Texas, brought down his gavel Tuesday afternoon to start a congressional hearing on Capitol Hill. In his opening statement to the committee, of which he is the chairman, the Texas congressman said there is a growing movement to overthrow the county's legal system and its Constitution. A movement he said is most prevalent in Texas.

item.title: Texas regulators will ask data centers to begin reporting their water usage
item.description: Utility regulators in Texas will start asking data centers and crypto-mining operations statewide within a narrow timeframe to share information about how much water they're using.

item.title: FBI scouring roadways in Catalina Foothills in search for Nancy Guthrie
item.description: The FBI's Phoenix bureau said its agents are “conducting an extensive search” of the Catalina Foothills in Arizona.

item.title: 'Dawson's Creek' actor James Van Der Beek dead at 48
item.description: James Van Der Beek, who rose to teen idol status in the show "Dawson's Creek," has died after a battle with colorectal cancer.

item.title: 2 toddlers in Katy dead in drowning, sheriff says
item.description: Two toddlers at a Katy home are being taken to a hospital in what Harris County authorities call a potential drowning on Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: Light rain Wednesday morning, sun by the afternoon
item.description: Patchy fog and sea fog remain the biggest weather impacts this week as Southeast Texas stays warm and humid, with limited rain chances through midweek.

item.title: Houston police give its first plans for FIFA 2026 World Cup
item.description: Houston is making plans to host the FIFA 2026 World Cup, with several law enforcement agencies working together to ensure safety and security for the event, including road closures, crowd control, and plans to support teams and international supporters.
